text: Lynngosa is a blue dragon located atop a tower in the Sapphire Enclave in Valdrakken.
Lydalia Runeseeker is a blood elf located in Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span. Two Dragonscale Explorers hand her books.

Lyandris Thorngale was a night elf member of the Druids of the Flame who planned with her sister Solarys to leave the cult. While Solarys went first, she expected her siblings to come as well. Thaeldus, on the other hand, wanted to stay in the Flame and killed Lyandris as she was trying to leave with the Flame's strategic documents. Her body was found by an adventurer, sent by Solarys, at the Smoldering Copse in the Emerald Dream.

Mace Specialization was a passive racial trait granted to all human and dwarf characters. It grants an expertise bonus while using mace-class weapons. When dual wielding different types of weapons, Mace Specialization is applied to each weapon individually, so that if you dual wield a mace and an axe, only attacks made with the mace benefit from Mace Specialization. When dual wielding two maces, all of your attacks will benefit from Mace Specialization. For attacks that only use the main hand weapon, such as a rogue's Sinister Strike, only your mainhand expertise matters. While wielding a Two-Handed Mace, or a One-Handed Mace in the Main hand, this racial also grants 1% spell hit. Dual wield

Mabel Solaj is a human general goods vendor located in the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire in Duskwood. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Mabel was killed by the fanatical Night Watchers who joined the Veiled Hand cult.

Mag'har Captive is a Mag'har orc who survived the onslaught of Sunspring Post, Nagrand but was captured by the Murkblood Broken. He can be found in one of the houses in the ruined village under the guard of two Broken, waiting for rescue from the Horde.
Maeva Snowbraid is a dwarf robe vendor located at Maeva's Mystical Apparel in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge.

Maer-thiss was a blood elf. He traveled to the hut of the witch doctor Zul'ajik, along with his companions the dwarf Gimbolt Surehammer, and the goblin Ziggler. They visited the troll in order to hire him to perform a ritual to contact spirits which would lead to the Demonwell. Because of Zul'ajik's hatred for goblins, Ziggler chose stay to outside of the camp and tinker on his clockwork dwarf. While under the influence of blue mushrooms, Ziggler interrupted the ritual when he piloted the clockwork dwarf through the camp and trampled both the troll's tent and Maer-thiss. Gimbolt decided to flee with Ziggler, while Maer-thiss and Zul'ajik decided to kill them both.
Maethor Skyshadow is a night elf poison and reagent vendor located at Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.
Mack Fearsen is a human often seen in the company of Samir, Adarrah, and Budd Nedreck.

Maeve Barleybrew is a dwarf who stands beside the Barleybrew tent advertising their particular brews at the Brewfest Grounds in Dun Morogh. If you pick up a Alcohol-Free Brewfest Sampler and throw it, the Brewmaidens will toss you another refill.
Maddox was a noble whose only interest was himself, he wanted to retake Andorhal for his own fame. Although an egocentric man he was ultimately fighting for a good cause.
Magdala Copperpick is a dwarf general goods vendor in the Alliance held Amber Caverns in the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
Madison Clark is a human cook vendor located at the Lunarfall Inn in .
Maeve Hopwash is a dwarf located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Machinist Sparkswift is a gnome located at Sprocket's Garage in Stormshield where she is doing maintenance work on an extractor.
Machinist Clockspan is a gnome located at Sprocket's Garage in Stormshield where he is doing maintenance work on a steam tank.
MacDugal was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.
Maelisandra Venitox is a night elf located in Val'sharah. She is the target of the world quest Poisoned Waters, given by Celestine of the Harvest.
Magdalena Dusklake is a night elf vendor located at the Sundersong Glade in Val'sharah.
Mag'har Pitfighter is a Mag'har orc located at Garadar in Nagrand. There are several Sunspring Post Orphans and Bleeding Hollow Refugees watching him.
Madeline Netley is a human stable master located in the Netley Inn in Stormsong Valley.

Mac was a 14 year old boy who volunteered to serve as a guard in the Stormwind Stockade when the army was sent off to the front. He reprimanded some of the prisoners for tearing their wool blankets to make scarves, a symbol of their gang. For that, Mac was stabbed in the back and killed, leading to his grandmother Nikova Raskol wanting revenge.

Mad-Eye Carrey is a rare elite human found in the Hoard of Shimmermaw of Hornswog Grounds in northeastern Forbidden Reach. Alongside First Mate Ovdah and Navigator Bi-Yun, they collectively serve as the Mad-Eye Carrey vignette.
Maedormi is a bronze dragon in visage form located in Thaldraszus.
Maelorna Brightborne is a blood elf located at the Ruins of Drekazera in Zaralek Cavern.
Magenius is an orc reagent vendor located in the Drag in Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with Asoran.
Magis Sparkmantle is a gnome mage trainer located in Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He defended the town during the Legion Invasions.
Magister Hawkhelm was a rare blood elf found in Azshara. She accompanied Magus Rimtori on her expedition.

Magistrate Marduke is a human ghost located by the entrance to the Scholomance on Caer Darrow in the Western Plaguelands. He is normally invisible, and can only be seen once the player had equipped the Spectral Essence item from the quest Kirtonos the Herald (quest). This item is no longer given, but players who kept theirs before Cataclysm struck can still see him. Marduke was most likely a magistrate and leading citizen of the town of Caer Darrow. When the evil of Scholomance consumed the town and killed the residents, most citizens were left as simple, mindless ghosts going through the motions of their daily lives. However, Marduke, though dead, remembers all that happened and actively so
Magistrate Randavarr is the half-elf ruler of the town council of the township of Valgarde in the Howling Fjord. He is a skilled scout and warrior.

Maggore is a Grimtotem tauren and member of Sparkeye's team. He was wounded by Lo'Gosh in a battle with Rehgar's team. As said by Sparkeye, he was not able to recuperate until the tournament in Dire Maul.
Magistrix Lambriesse is a blood elf Justice Points vendor located in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary of Dalaran.
Magister Sarien is a blood elf Justice Points vendor located in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary of Dalaran.

Magustrix Iruvia is a blood elf found with the other tier 9 armor vendors just west of the Crusaders' Coliseum between the Silver Covenant and Sunreaver Pavilions at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. She sells weapons and armor to members of the Horde. Her Sunreaver compatriots are: * sells Conquest-level tier 9 * sells Triumph-level tier 9 * sells Heroic-level tier 9

Magister Hathorel is a blood elf in service to the Sunreavers. He plays a role in the restoration of Quel'Delar, and later survived the Purge of Dalaran. He took up arms with the Sunreaver Onslaught on the Isle of Thunder.
Magmaw is the first boss in Blackwing Descent, though he could be done second, after Omnotron Defense System.
Magma Plated Battlearmor is the tier 11 blood death knight set.
Magma Plated Battlegear is the tier 11 frost/unholy death knight set.

Magister Serena is a Kirin Tor mage found at Khadgar's Tower. Alliance players seeking to build an Arcane Sanctum will work with her, and she becomes a follower for their garrison after the quest line is complete. She is a passionate frost mage. Her counterpart, Magister Krelas, is a proud fire mage.

Magister Krelas is a Kirin Tor mage found at Khadgar's Tower. Horde players seeking to build an Arcane Sanctum will work with him, and he becomes a follower for their garrison after the questline is complete. He is a proud fire mage. His counterpart, Magister Serena, is a passionate frost mage. He is polite and formal in his disposition, and treats the player with the utmost respect from the moment he is first met.
Magistrix Chillbreeze is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Magistrix Soulblaze is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.

Magnar Icebreaker was a legendary vrykul king who wielded the Blackwyrm Armaments, crafted from a scale of Neltharion himself, and led his people to countless victories. During the Battle of Suramar Pass, he and his son Hruthnir were betrayed and murdered by servants of Helya, and while Hruthnir was taken into the Halls of Valor by Odyn, Magnar's spirit languished alongside his body where it was buried in the Tomb of the Old Kings on Shield's Rest.
Magister Dalhyr was a blood elf battlemaster for Wintergrasp located in Thunder Bluff.
Magister Langley is a human found in Stormshield of Ashran where he serves as a PvP vendor.

Mai'Zoth is an ogre mage found in the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound in Northern Stranglethorn. Mai'Zoth used an artifact called the Mind's Eye to corrupt Colonel Kurzen. Both Brother Nimetz and Kin'weelay want the Mind's Eye; Nimetz to stop others from suffering the same fate as Kurzen, and Kin'weelay to save Yenniku from the mind-altering elixirs of Zanzil the Outcast.
Maiden's Folly Log is the captain's log book for the ship Maiden's Folly found in the Arathi Highlands.

Major Mills is a level 50 human located on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle, but as a soldier, he was likely killed in combat or from the bomb.
Magus Fansy Goodbringer is a human located near the Violet Hold in Dalaran. He can provide directions for various locations in Dalaran.
Maigra Keenfeather is a Wildhammer dwarf gryphon riding trainer located near the inn, next to the Gryphon Master at Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.

Magus Bisp is a human located on top of the scout tower at Hearthglen in the Western Plaguelands. He has been supplying the local gnolls with necromancy items. After the adventurer turns himself in for Bisp's murder, Tirion cheers him/her and tells him/her that they have been hunting the traitor for weeks.
Magtil Landstalker is an orc vendor located outside the Bladespire Citadel in Frostfire Ridge.
Maiev is the leader of the Watchers. She began a hunt for Illidan Stormrage after his release from the barrow prisons.
Magraloth is a pit lord located in the Annihilan Pits in Krokuun.
Magus Delitha is a human located at Boralus Harbor in Boralus.
Mahku is an orc innkeeper located at Windfall Cavern in Stormsong Valley.
Mairadormi is a bronze dragon innkeeper located in the Parting Glass in Valdrakken.
Maivastrasza is a red dragon in blood elf visage located in Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Makaru is an orc mining trainer located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.

Malar Bravehorn is a tauren member of the Argent Dawn and was taken prisoner by the Scarlet Crusade in the Scarlet Enclave. When the death knights of Acherus invaded the Enclave, the prisoners traded owners. Tauren death knights have a chance to execute Bravehorn.
Malakai Stone was a human of the Stormwind Army. He was killed by Elwynn murlocs.
Makar Stonebinder is an orc found in the Boneslag in Frostfire Ridge. He has a totem. He is later in the Thunder Pass.

Malda Brewbelly is a pandaren hunter captain of the Alliance, who served in Ashran and would later appear at Raven's Glory, the Black Rook Hold arena. In Ashran, Brewbelly or another random Alliance Captain will spawn each time the Alliance reinforcements total reaches 200 or 100.
Malden is a human paladin located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Makogg Emberblade is an orc found in Iron Docks as a part of the Grimrail Enforcers along with Neesa Nox and Ahri'ok Dugru. He is a Burning Blade swordsman and an elite mercenary in the employ of the Blackfuse Company.
Maldur Goldmantle is a dwarf located at Bronzebeard's Vault in Stormshield. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, he traveled to Val'sharah.
Makthel is an orc located in the Gormaul Tower in Frostfire Ridge, after it is claimed by the Frostwolf Orcs.
Makasa Flintwill is a human girl who comes from Booty Bay, with her ancestors coming from Stromgarde. She is a capable hunter and tracker.
Malachisera is a green dragon located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.

Malgen Longspear is a centaur hunter, and is part of Theldren's team of gladiators at the Blackrock Depths arena. He has a pet called Gnashjaw. His weapon, Malgen's Long Bow, can sometimes be found in the Arena Spoils after defeating Theldren's team.

Malgin Barleybrew is a rare dwarf found in the Bael Modan Excavation, on a platform overlooking the digsite, just east of the chasm in the Southern Barrens. He was standing behind a bar in Bael Modan before the Cataclysm. He is one of the closest Alliance vendors to the Razorfen Kraul and Razorfen Downs instances, selling an assortment of alcoholic beverages.
Maluressian is a night elf stable master located at Astranaar in Ashenvale. He would later be killed by the Horde during his sleep.

Malissa is a human poison vendor located behind a building in Darkshire in Duskwood. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Malissa was seen cowering in fear when the fanatical Night Watchers joined the Veiled Hand cult.
Malosh is an orc warrior trainer located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Malygen is a night elf general goods vendor located at Talonbranch Glade in Felwood.

Maloric is an orc located at the Ruins of Shandaral, southwest of the Mirror of Twilight in Crystalsong Forest. He is the squire of the Black Knight and has made the Argent Crusade believe that he was being sent here by his master every day to gather some lumber.
Malgrim Stormhand was an orc from the Thunderlord clan. He was asked by Fenris to stay behind with twelve orcs to protect the Dark Portal. His status remains unknown.

Malgar is an orc hunter and member of the Garad'kra. His companion is a wolf named Remnes. Formerly a drifter and lone wolf, Malgar preferred to stay far away from the Horde and anything he perceived as a life of servitude or slavery, until he became embroiled—and ended up playing a central role—in the Garad'kra's mission to stop the centaur threat after the Cataclysm.

Mallia is a Dragonmaw orc residing at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands. She was present during the first Azerothian Kosh'harg festival at Razor Hill in Durotar, where she was extended an invitation to join the Earthen Ring by the new Farseer Aggralan. However, she mentioned that old prejudices were not so easily put down among the orcs of Azeroth, and that she needed to spend time scrying the outcomes before Artesh and her decide, as they must do as the spirits will despite their personal feelings.
Malmo is a pygmy witch doctor of Oostan Sor village located on Lost Isles.
Mama Morton is a human innkeeper and vendor located in Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands. It's unknown if she survived the Ironmarch.
Malley is a dwarf vendor located at the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

Malkor was an orc assigned to deliver and place a bomb attached on the Dark Portal to make sure the humans didn't follow the Horde into Draenor after their incursion into Azeroth to retrieve artifacts. He told the orc Kra'kul that it was just a shield meant to protect them when they crossed over to Draenor to let him take the blame for it. His status remains unknown.
Malroc Stonesunder is a orc accompanied by his two advisors Lieutenant Bruna and Lieutenant Drogg at Anguish Point in .
Malrok Thornscar is an orc located in Veil Akraz in the Spires of Arak.
Malgosh Shadowkeeper is an orc located in Spirit Whisper Hollow in .
Malgurk is an orc located at The Fel Forge in Tanaan Jungle. He needs to be spoken with in Commander in the Field! (Horde).
Mama is an orc located in Nagrand. She was killed by Worgskin the Savage.
Malukah Lightsong is a blood elf located in Warspear. She sells Warlords Season 3 equipment.

Malto is a human mage who is a patron of the Hearthstone inn. Malto is an expert in matters arcane, and a fountain of sage wisdom. The first-ever guest of the tavern, long before anyone can remember. Mentor to all, and friend of Harth. He also helps players get through the first, second and last wings of Icecrown along with other adventures.
Malorian Tailwind is a human located in Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.
Malys Feltouch is a blood elf located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Alliance players.
Malixia is a black dragon ghost located at the Veiled Ossuary in Thaldraszus. She is only active at night.

Mangletooth is a quilboar and the new leader of the Razormane tribe in the Southern Barrens. Before escaping Camp Taurajo, he was a quest giver tasking Horde adventurers with killing of the other quilboar.
Mangorn Flinthammer is a dwarf heavy armor vendor located in the Commons in Ironforge.
Manfred Staller is a human leatherworking trainer inside the Legendary Leathers shop within the Magus Commerce Exchange of Dalaran.
Maniacal Madgard is a Pale dire orc located at The Pit in Gorgrond.
Manda Darlowe is a human archaeology trainer found in Stormshield.
Manager Yerold is a human located at Anglepoint Packing District in Tiragarde Sound.
Manceroy Flamefist is a human located in Battle of Dazar'alor. He summons phoenixes and transforms into one as well.
Mandos Fogwing is a night elf located at the Wreck of the Old Blanchy in Nazjatar.
Manny is the house cat companion of the blood elf child Nova, located at Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods.
Many Will Fall is an Arms warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Focus in Battle, Precise Strikes, and Unending Rage traits.
Manny Read is a human located in Three-Falls Lookout in the Azure Span.

Mardant Strongoak is a night elf druid trainer located in Aldrassil in Teldrassil. During the Firelands Invasion he appears in The Regrowth in Mount Hyjal patrolling alongside Celestine of the Harvest, Zen'tabra and Gart Mistrunner. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Marie Holdston is a human blacksmithing trainer and weapon vendor located on Theramore Isle of Dustwallow Marsh. It's unknown if she survived the Attack on Theramore Isle, though a Theramore Citizen in the Siege of Orgrimmar uses her exact appearance.

Marez Cowl is an orc warlock member of the Syndicate found in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands. Dark Ranger Alina wants the bloodstone orb that Marez carries, while Captain Nials wants Marez's head.

Marijah is a human female turned into a ghost. The being is clad in simple gaments, though her translucent form makes it difficult to see any details of what she wears and carries. She was a scout in life. She speaks Common, Dwarven, and Giant.
Marge is a human found in Grizzly Hills. She was originally located at Hatchet Hills in the Ghostlands.
Marcus is a well-traveled human paladin and the main character of the erotic "Steamy Romance Novels" series. He owns a warhorse.
Maridan was a soldier who trained under Sergeant in the Durnholde military. His status is unknown.
Mark Hanes is a human located in Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.
Marisalira is a blood elf food and drink vendor located at the Sunreaver's Command in Crystalsong Forest.
Margrave Dhakar is a human death knight of the Knights of the Ebon Blade.
Marcella Bloom is a human bartender found in A Hero's Welcome in Dalaran.
Marissa Everwatch is a human innkeeper found at the Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.
Marga Bearbrawn was a dwarf Strand of the Ancients battlemaster located in the Hall of Arms in the Military Ward in Ironforge. She only appeared during the Call to Arms: Strand of the Ancients.
Marcus Windthorne was the captain of the ship, the Stormchild, which was temporarily ensconced in Menethil Harbor. He encountered the draenei Iridi and allowed her to enter the harbor.
Marina DeSirrus is a rare human and one of the grave robbers residing at Sven Yorgen and Lars' old camp at the Darkened Bank in Duskwood.
Marc Daiton is a human general goods vendor at Plaguewood Tower within the Eastern Plaguelands.

Margolag is an orc who aided the Horde in the battle of Northwatch Hold. Upon their victory among of the Horde forces became confused when Garrosh Hellscream decided to wait instead of pressing the attack upon Theramore. In response members of the Horde like Baine Bloodhoof, Vol'jin, Frandis Farley, and Kelantir Bloodblade gathered together to discuss what Garrosh was thinking and Margolag was present not only for himself but as a representative for Eitrigg. Unknown to everyone present treachery from within had tipped their meeting off to the Warchief and his bodyguard the Blackrock orc Malkorok. While Margolag was not punished he was ordered to return to his encampment. When Garrosh gave th
Marcy Lewis is a human stable master located in Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands. It's unknown if she survived the Ironmarch.
Mariel Dawnsong is a night elf located at the Talrendis Point in Azshara. She was present during the Legion Invasions.

Margaret was a human from Gilneas and neighbor to Lorna Crowley. She gave her advice to board up her windows and buy a reinforced door to which she agreed. Lorna was also going to give her a mastiff to protect her children once they were trained. Along with the letter, Lorna gave her a bit of gun powder to protect herself as a thank you for helping her father. Her current whereabouts are unknown.
Marianne Levine is a human located at Lunarfall's Tannery in . She accepts Raw Beast Hide work orders creating Burnished Leathers.
Margo Steelfinger is a dwarf located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Marius Sunshard is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, he appears at the Dranosh'ar Blockade at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.
Marek is an orc found running and walking inside the Bladespire Citadel in Frostfire Ridge. Occasionally, he runs to Der'shway and Dean'na who clap, speak, or laugh with him.
Mariella Ward (or Mariella the Heretic) is a defector priest of the Scarlet Onslaught.
Marick Ven is an orc located at the Heart of Azeroth. He recruits Earthen Ring Protectors.
Marcus Howlingdale is a human child located at North Pass Caverns in Drustvar.
Marjorie Foster is a human blacksmith located at Fallhaven in Drustvar.

Marjuk was an ogre commander of the Dire Maul Gordunni clan. He and Wordok had the same roles - capturing slaves for King Gordok's arena fights. He intended to challenge Gordok in order to rule the Gordunni. Among his raids was a raid against the Woodpaw gnolls where he killed Gnaw. He also killed Karrga's father over a pig. With Wordok and Arkus, they climbed upon Skypeak and stole One-Eye's three cubs. At some point after the Cataclysm, he traveled to the east to find new slaves. He encountered the Feral Scar yetis at their new location. While capturing them, he and his men were attacked by Feral Scar leader as well as by Aramar, Makasa, Sivet, and Hackle. The ogres were all defeated, with

Marjani Flintwill is a human pirate captain of the Makemba of the Blackwater Raiders's fleet. She is very capable with various weapons. At some point, she dueled with Reigol Valdread of the SI:7 on the Makemba some time after the Second War. She had four children - Adashe, Akashinga, Amahle, and Makasa - each with different father, raising them all by herself on the Makemba that operated out of Booty Bay. She was tough on them, especially on Makasa as she saw herself in her youngest, teaching them the life of a pirate. She also told Makasa tales about the SI:7 agents. She was capable of tenderness and kindness but only after a good day. She believed that Makasa could one day rule the Blackwa
Marcy Burns is a human blacksmithing vendor located at Burnsie's Smithey in Boralus.
Marius Harrison is a human located at Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound.

Marie Davenport is a human located in the Davenport Residence in Millstone Hamlet in Stormsong Valley. She will offer 5 Marie's Famous Cookies per 20 Tigule's Strawberry Ice Cream after her quests have been completed. In her own days, she was quite the firecracker in her day. At some point, she tried to teach her grandson, Charles how to bake, but the effort was seemingly unfortunate since Sergeant Calvin remembers Its smoke. By the time the Alliance emissary delivered her lost package of tea, she had the local residents running errands and collecting various supplies in order to put the hamlet back in order and save it from the ettins. This included Charles. With the collected flour and gun
Marilyn Hood is a human located in Brennadam in Stormsong Valley.
Mark Waldorf is a human located in Mariner's Row in Boralus.
Mark Waligora is a human located in Hops, Line, & Sinker Brewing in Boralus.
Mareen Sherwood is a human located at the Crimson Coast in Drustvar. She is a part of the Crimson Cutthroats, a notorious band of outlaws.
Marcus Swiftwind is a human druid transformed into a thornclaw located in Drustvar.

Marine Anderson is a soldier onboard the Lady Mehley, the boat that runs between Theramore Isle and Menethil Harbor. Anderson is a member of the Theramore Marines, and was assumed to be onboard for the protection of the crew. However, she, along with Halters, were assigned to guard the passengers as it is felt the ship goes to Theramore enough. Although she can be attacked, she will not strike the first blow.

Marine Halters is a soldier onboard the Lady Mehley, the boat that runs between Theramore Isle and Menethil Harbor. Halters is a member of the Theramore Marines, and was assumed to be onboard for the protection of the crew. However, he along with Anderson were assigned to guard the passengers as it's felt the ship goes to Theramore enough. Although he can be attacked, he will not strike the first blow.
Marshal Dughan is a human located in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. He is part of the Stormwind Army and is in charge of the security of Goldshire and the surrounding areas.
Marniel Amberlight is a blood elf innkeeper located at Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.

Marrod Silvertongue is a level 70 "human" found at Fort Wildervar in Howling Fjord. He's apparently more than he appears: Although he appears to be an ordinary human male, his type in the game files is actually giant.
Marshal Jacob Alerius is a human located in the Silver Covenant Pavilion of the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown as part of the Argent Tournament. He was present during Death Rising.
Marshal Expeditions is a a non-aligned expedition troupe that is led by the human Marshal siblings: Williden and Hol'anyee.

Markri was a Highborne night elf wizard and adept at summoning creatures; especially elementals. At some point he made Tablet of Markri and the Rune of Markri for all of the Highborne of Eldarath to see.
Markus is a human boy located at the house of Clara Charles in Elwynn Forest. He can be found in the garden just outside the house. He is likely a relative of Clara, possibly her son.

Martha Goslin is a human located in her house in the Culling of Stratholme wing of the Caverns of Time. She is approached by Jena Anderson who need some flour to make bread. The third Plagued Grain crate is outside her house. It's unknown what became of her.
Markel Smythe is a human located at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Marrok is an orc general goods vendor located at the Mor'shan Rampart in the Northern Barrens.
Marketa is the Alliance warlock leader in Stormshield Outpost, Ashran. She serves as the Warlock Gateways NPC for the Alliance in Ashran.
Marshal Karsh Stormforge is an Alliance general in Ashran, found in the main building in Stormshield Outpost. He also serves as Honor gear vendor.
Marshal Lyrdrea Daybreaker is a blood elf prisoner of the Alliance in Ashran, found in the basement of Stormshield Stronghold.

Marla Fipps is a human buried at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glade. She would be killed by her undead husband but she loved him so much that she wanted him to be buried with her as her final wish. This is a wish that was granted by her friend Novice Elreth and a Forsaken adventurer.
Martens was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.
Marlan Blackfire is a human mage located in Azsuna. Marlan evaluates the relics brought to him by others looking to join the Empyrean Society.

Marshal Frazer is a human located in Greyfang Enclave in Dalaran. He is the Legion Season 3 Quartermaster that sells Season 3 and Season 3 Elite armor tokens for Echoes of Battle and Echoes of Domination.
Marksman Rupa is a tauren hunter located at Deliverance Point in the Broken Shore.

Marlowe Algerson is a human located at Hatherford in Tiragarde Sound. She brings flowers to the grave of her mother, Petula, who was recently killed for being the witch that caused trouble at Algerson Lumber Yard.
Martha Mae is a human located in Freehold in Tiragarde Sound. She runs Hands on Deck with her assistant Hands.
Marksman Julyen is a deceased blood elf located in Zuldazar.
Marlowe Lexvold is a human located at the Amber Waves in Stormsong Valley. He can be found working on a couple of Busted Farmhands.
Markona is an orc located at the Wreck of the Hungry Riverbeast in Nazjatar.
Marshal Inora Wyrmbane is a human that would appear in Storming Stormwind. She was replaced by Mage-Commander Lyra.
Marsha Tallmark is a human located at the Life Vault Ruins in the Waking Shores.
Marren is a dwarf stable master located at Rusza'thar Reach in the Ohn'ahran Plains. She tried to tame a local breezehunter falcon, but almost fell to her death.

Master Handler Sylvester is a blood elf that sends "A Very Special Delivery" letter, which includes the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition companions. He also sends the "Special Delivery" letter that includes the Netherwhelp's Collar, with a special bonus Lurky's Egg for European players, and Grunty's Heavy Murloc Egg from BlizzCon 2009. He also sent the special mounts Swift Zhevra and X-53 Touring Rocket from the original Recruit A Friend program.
Master Marksman is a hunter talent located on tier 8 of the Marksmanship tree.
Captain Marwyn was a member of the Lordaeronian King's Guard and one of Prince Arthas Menethil's captains during the Third War.

Martin Victus is a human found in the Pit of Saron of Icecrown Citadel as a slave. After the defeat of Forgemaster Garfrost, he leads the Alliance slave army to fight Scourgelord Tyrannus. After Tyrannus is killed Martin begins a speech about his debt to the adventurers who freed him and how nothing can beat the Horde and Alliance when they set aside by their difference only to killed by Sindragosa before he can finish. His Horde counterpart is Gorkun Ironskull.
Masha Swiftcut is an orc serving the Horde in Alterac Valley. She patrols the Coldtooth Mine while it's under Horde control.

Marud is an orc mage trainer located in the Arcane Enclave in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. He was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade. He joined the Tirisgarde and is located in the Hall of the Guardian where he can be seen instructing Tirisgarde Apprentices casting spells at a Greater Bulwark Construct. Marud was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar. He was standing next to Arcweaver Kashra, where he reminisced how Thrall had spared her after the Siege of Orgrimmar due to her potential as a mage.
Master Li Fei is the spirit of a pandaren elder first appearing in the Cave of Meditation on the Wandering Isle. He re-appears in the Shrine of Inner-Light to test adventurers.
Master Marshall is a human herbalism and inscription trainer located in the sanctuary area of Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit.
Maseel is a high elf general goods vendor located at Beryl Egress in Winterspring.
Mary Ann Skweres is a dwarf located at Lake Dumont in Feralas.
Master Brandom is a human blacksmithing and mining trainer located in the sanctuary area of Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit. His work station is behind the Shrine of the Ox.
Master Cheng is a pandaren monk found on the Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit.

Master Hsu is a tauren monk found at the Training Grounds of Peak of Serenity of Kun-Lai Summit. He is sparring with Monk Trainees. He survived the Burning Legion's attack on the Peak and now resides at the Temple of the Five Dawns on The Wandering Isle, serving as the mission master.
Masha Longhorn is a member of the Druid of the Talon camp at Skysea Ridge in Gorgrond. Currently, she sells a small assortment of food items.

Mary Brown was a human deckhand on the Wavestrider. She assisted Captain Greydon Thorne in the attack against the Bloodsail Buccaneers on the Sea King, personally freeing the captured crew, along with Durgan One-God. She fought against the Hidden and Malus personally when they attacked the ship. The captain bested her, but she kept fighting when last seen by Aramar Thorne and Makasa Flintwill.
Martin Kevens is an orc located at the Port of Zandalar in Dazar'alor. He was replaced by Ransa Greyfeather.

Masa Tashi is a blood elf tourist located on the northern steps of Dazar'alor in Zuldazar, next to Tina Fun. The two occasionally take a S.E.L.F.I.E., to the annoyance of a nearby Rastari Enforcer. He is present in Zanchul during Talanji's coronation. He and Tina Fun traveled to the Dragon Isles. They can be found at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus.
Master Gunner Line is a drunk man located at Thresher's Wharf in Stormsong Valley. He tells fish stories with Coxswain Hook and "Sinker".
Marua was a night elf Sentinel. After Rifen killed Commander Anaris Windwood, he rolled to his feet and made a clean, swift strike across Marua's throat that almost severed her head from her body.
Master Engineer Hafren is a dwarf that was encountered by Horde champions in Tiragarde Sound during the Fourth War.
Massa Cloudsage is a Mag'har orc located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Alliance players.
Martin Goodchilde is a Forsaken priest trainer located in the Barracks in Orgrimmar.
Marvin Sipsquall is a human located at Tailored by Brineweaver in the Tradewinds Market in Boralus.
Master Handler is a row 8 Beast Mastery hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Snake Bite.

Master Smith Burninate is a dwarf general goods, blacksmithing, meat, and drink vendor located at Thorium Point in the Searing Gorge. He is a quest giver for the Thorium Brotherhood. His quests were originally meant to be repeated to get Thorium Brotherhood reputation up to , but after patch 4.0.3a are available after the quest Welcome to the Brotherhood.

Mathogg was an orcish military leader who led an orcish encampment north of the Darkspear village shortly after the Third War. The encampment was raided by the Kolkar centaur and its inhabitants were taken captive. He was found by Rexxar, Rokhan and Chen Stormstout, who agreed to help the captured orc. The trio of heroes hunted down and killed the Kolkar Khan Gragtor, taking from him the key needed to release Mathogg and his comrades. Upon release, Mathogg vowed that, now that his people were safe, he would travel to Orgrimmar to lend his services to the Horde.

Mathrengyl Bearwalker is a night elf druid trainer located in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. He also sells Packets of Tharlendris Seeds and Evergreen Pouches. He used to be Fandral Staghelm's direct assistant and second. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was caught in the chaos and could be saved.
Master Sergeant Lorin Thalmerok is a dwarf stable master located at Honor Hold in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Master Pyreanor is a blood elf paladin trainer located in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
Matero Zeshuwal is a blood elf warlock located at Ratchet in the Northern Barrens. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Master Smith Devin Brevig is a human and the blacksmithing supplier for Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight.

Mastram is a Wildhammer dwarf elder of Aerie Peak. He had promised the young Wildhammer dwarves he would tell them a story one night, and so he did, narrating how Khardros Wildhammer defeated Modgud at Grim Batol. Between those listening the tale were Lieren and Keers.

Matilda Brightlink is a dwarf woman located in the Eventide quarter of Dalaran, inside the Langrom's Leather & Links. During the purge of Dalaran, she was standing on a crate in a battle stance and occasionally cheering.
Matias Volkert is a night elf located at Lake Dumont in Feralas.
Master Woo is a dwarf located at the Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit.
Mastermind is the Shadow priest secondary stat attunement, focusing on haste.
Matron Magah is an orc innkeeper located at Bor'gorok Outpost in the Borean Tundra. She was originally just a food vendor as Provisioner Magah.
Matron Nessa is a human located at the Greyfang Enclave in Dalaran.
Master Oakheart is a dwarf found underground. He is a dwarf in search of Woecleaver and asks Marin to retrieving it.
Matilda Clark is a human located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus. She strolls through the market with her daughter Louisa.
Master Shapeshifter Lyara is a night elf located at the Ruins of Lordaeron during the Battle for Lordaeron.
Mastus Snowspray is a void elf located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players.
Matron Dreya is a dwarf located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players.
Mathog Hideflayer is a Mag'har orc located on the Defiant Dragonscale in Durotar.

Matt Johnson is a human mining trainer located in Darkshire in Duskwood. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Matt was killed by the fanatical Night Watchers who joined the Veiled Hand cult.
Matron Tikkit is a Mag'har orc innkeeper located at Garadar in Nagrand.
Matron Qualia is a Mag'har orc general goods vendor located at Garadar in Nagrand.
Mawg Grimshot is an orc found at Stonebreaker Hold in Terokkar Forest.

Matt is a human boy who lives in the town of Goldshire. He loves to go fishing but appears to not be very good at this due to inexperience. He will walk from the pier at Crystal Lake to the Goldshire pond, attempting to find fish to catch.
Matt Bruxworthy is a Forsaken hunter trainer at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He has a pet lion named Hobbes.
Maurice Essman is a human blacksmithing supplies vendor found at Surwich in the Blasted Lands.
Matron Suma is an orc located at Stonefang Outpost in Frostfire Ridge.

Mavvus Gingersnap is a gnome found in Stormshield Keep in Ashran, and is a member of the Explorers' League. She is looking for Feezzel Gingersnap. Later, during the conflict on the Seething Shore between the Alliance and Horde, Mavvus could be found onboard the Skyguard gunship, alongside Feezzel.
Matthew Deyling is a human located at the Lunarfall in and in Stormwind Harbor. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Mawmaul is an orc located at the Broken Horn Village in Gorgrond.

Mavelith was a night elf who sought out Illidan Stormrage in Outland to fight the Burning Legion. He seemed to find everything funny, and took pleasure in others' pain. After undergoing the rites to become a demon hunter, he threw himself from the battlements of Karabor out of horror at what he had become.
Matthew Browning is a human located at the Old Coast Path in Azsuna.
Matt DeVine is a human located at Deliverance Point in the Broken Shore.

Matthew Glensorrow is a human warrior located in Skyhold, home of the Valarjar within the Halls of Valor. As a soldier of the Alliance and member of the 7th Legion, he acts as a recruiting officer for 7th Legion shock troops at the behest of the Battlelord. To act as recruiter, Mattew was sent to Skyhold once Lord Darius Crowley joined the Valarjar as a champion in the war against the Burning Legion. If a member of the Alliance, the Valarjar Battlelord could thus reinforce their armies with the elite of the Alliance military. Matthew was stationed near other recruiters just off the entrance to Skyhold.
Matt Fieler is a human who patrol at Tradewinds Market in Boralus.
Matt Ferguson is a human located in Hops, Line, & Sinker Brewing in Boralus.
Matthew Rowland is a human located in Blushwater Brook in Tiragarde Sound.
Matthew Zelling is a human located at Tidebreak Summit in Stormsong Valley.
Matthew Gandorian is a human located in Beacon Hill in Stormsong Valley.
Matthew McKeown is a concept and character artist who works for Blizzard Entertainment.
Matthias Darkwall is a void elf vendor located at Skytop Observatory in the Waking Shores.

Mazrigos was an orc far seer and leader of the Blackrock Slavers who defended the demon gate which the lich Kel'Thuzad used to commune with the demon lord Archimonde. Arthas and Kel'Thuzad killed him along with four other orcs guarding the demon gate.

Maximillian Crowe is a human warlock and warlock trainer located in the cellar of the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest. He is notable for training novice warlocks in the ways of the dark arts.
Maxton Strang is a human mail armor vendor of Stormwind located at Nijel's Point in Desolace.
Max Luna is a human Arena battlemaster located in Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

Thane Maz Drachrip was a former ruler and thane of Hinterlands and the Wildhammer Clan of hill dwarves at Aerie Peak, he was in charge after the former thane Kurdran Wildhammer went through the Dark Portal. He acquired his position through a hereditary monarchy, held by the Wildhammer Clan, who proved themselves by might. He was a great fighter and windrider. As part of clan-like caste system a thane rules each clan, and the mightiest thane rules Aerie Peak, this has been the Wildhammer Clan since the War of the Three Hammers. As Maz held the position of thane of Aerie Peak it would mean that he proved himself the mightiest thane, or at least his family had proven themselves, the mightiest c
Mayor Quimby is a human located in New Avalon Town Hall as being the mayor of the town in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.
Meara is a Wildhammer dwarf located at Firebeard's Patrol in the Twilight Highlands. Meara's Dried Roses are a quest item for Cailin Longfellow's quest Small Comforts.
Mazuru is an orc blademaster found in Sparkrocket Outpost at the Krasarang Wilds.

Maxwell is a human soldier located in Northrend and took part in the War against the Lich King. He fought alongside Thassarian, before the death knight was recalled to lead the Unit S. His current whereabouts are unknown.
Maxine Quickshot is a gnome hunter located in . She has a pet bear named Growler.
May Tirta is a human innkeeper located at the Khadgar's Tower in Talador.

Mayor Heathrow is a human located at Bradensbrook in Val'sharah. He is the mayor of the village and has a dim view of strangers being present in the area, and claims that they don't need help. Emmeline attributes this hostility to stress from being unable to locate his missing daughter, Penelope. Once his daughter was rescued, he indeed became more friendly.
Maynard Algerson is a human located at Algerson Lumber Yard in Tiragarde Sound.
